subject: integration
name: Your own SOCKS5 address
summary: Sends an app's or tab's traffic through a SOCKS5 server at an address the person types (none is set by default), over a plain TCP link. Whatever runs at that address sees this computer's address and every destination, and can read or change traffic that is not encrypted; nothing checks what it does. A proxy that cannot be reached refuses and never goes direct. Level 3, not 4: it relies on a party Orivon does not choose or check, and shows the person to it. Judged here by its publisher.
